Why the score was redesigned

The previous score was a fixed indicator sum. Calibration showed it was non-monotonic — a 50–59 score led to higher forward returns than 70–79. We replaced it with a walk-forward calibrated edge score rather than re-weighting to force the numbers.

Data quality audit

Every symbol is validated for missing/duplicate dates, null/infinite/non-finite values and minimum length. SPY > 252, QQQ > 252, TLT > 126 trading days required.

Provider provenance (who fetched each symbol, when)

Updated architecture

The browser no longer contacts Yahoo Finance. A scheduled GitHub Action fetches, validates and commits JSON; GitHub Pages serves the page with that data embedded.

Publish to GitHub Pages

  1. Upload index.html to the repository root (this is the only file the website needs).
  2. Also upload the .github/workflows/update-data.yml and pipeline/ folder so data refreshes automatically.
  3. Repository Settings → Pages → Deploy from a branch → main / (root). Your link appears within 1–2 minutes.
  4. Optionally click Actions → Update Market Data → Run workflow to refresh immediately.
Disclaimer：This dashboard is an educational research tool. It is not investment advice and does not account for your objectives, situation or needs. Backtested results are not a guarantee of future performance. Data: Yahoo Finance (server-side) with Stooq fallback, refreshed by a scheduled GitHub Action. Analysis uses walk-forward computation with no look-ahead.
